name: PHX
rootCause: On July 12, 2026, the PHX token contract on BNB Chain was exploited for 156.205683367 WBNB (≈$89,532), after an attacker manipulated PancakeSwap pool reserves via the token's flawed burn-and-sync logic in a flash-loan-aided transaction. A sell transfer on the PHX token burned tokens directly from the PancakeSwap PHX/WBNB pair, then synced reserves before crediting the net sell amount. This sequence let the attacker set an artificial reserve baseline and drain nearly all WBNB at a mispriced swap, violating AMM invariants.
